CalloutConfig.DispatchText: Someone is having trouble breathing and needs help.
CalloutConfig.DispatchVoiceLine: Dispatch to all units. A person is having breathing trouble nearby. Please respond.
CalloutConfig.EnRouteHelpText: Drive to the yellow marker, then get out and walk up to the patient.
CalloutConfig.OnSceneText: You're on scene. Check on the patient.
CalloutConfig.OnSceneVoiceLine: On scene. Checking on the patient now.

OnSceneTextVariants.string: There they are. Let's see how their breathing is.
You made it. Time to check on them.
On scene - let's help them catch their breath.

CalloutConfig.AssessmentHelpText: Press E (or X on controller) to help the patient.
CalloutConfig.ConversationHelpText: Press E (or X on controller) to talk to the patient.
CalloutConfig.TreatingText: Helping the patient with their breathing...

TreatingTextVariants.string: Helping them breathe nice and slow...
Calmly helping them catch their breath...
Getting their breathing back to normal...

PatientThanksTextVariants.string: Thanks, I can breathe so much easier now!
That helped a lot, thank you!
Feeling much better, thanks for your help!

CalloutConfig.ResolutionVoiceLine: Nice work. The patient is breathing easier now.

Injury.DispatchText: Someone has a mild wheeze and needs a hand with their inhaler.
Injury.DispatchVoiceLine: Dispatch to all units. A person has a mild wheeze nearby. Please respond.

DialogueLine.Speaker: Patient
DialogueLine.Text: I'm a bit wheezy... I just need my inhaler.

DialogueLine.Speaker: You
DialogueLine.Text: Here you go - nice slow breaths.

Injury.TreatedText: All better! Breathing is nice and easy again.

Injury.DispatchText: Someone is short of breath and needs help calming down.
Injury.DispatchVoiceLine: Dispatch to all units. A person is short of breath nearby. Please respond.

DialogueLine.Speaker: Patient
DialogueLine.Text: It's hard to catch my breath...

DialogueLine.Speaker: You
DialogueLine.Text: I've got you. Use your inhaler and breathe with me - in and out.

Injury.TreatingText: Coaching slow breaths and giving oxygen...
Injury.TreatedText: Nice work - breathing has settled and the patient feels much better.

Injury.DispatchText: Someone is having a bad asthma attack - needs the hospital.
Injury.DispatchVoiceLine: Dispatch to all units. A person is having a bad asthma attack nearby. Please respond quickly.

DialogueLine.Speaker: You
DialogueLine.Text: Stay calm, I'm giving you oxygen - we're going to the hospital now.

Injury.TransportedText: Great job! The patient is rushed to the hospital and is going to be okay.
